通知公告

6月26日台湾政治大学杨启正副教授、杨立行副教授学术讲座

2017-06-26 13:16:11 来源：华南师范大学心理学院 点击： 收藏本文

讲座一

题    目：Post-Concussion Syndrome: A Neuro-Psychological Disorder

主讲人：杨启正副教授(台湾政治大学)

时    间：2017年6月26日（星期一）下午3:00-4:10

地    点：心理学院201会议室

主讲人简介：

台湾政治大学的副教授，主要擅长领域；临床神经心理学，神经心理复健，和临床心理学。主要学术著作《台湾版额叶评估量表》《长庚大学中文字型流利度量表》

近五年有17篇学术论文发表在Brain Injury, Archives of Clinical Neuropsychology，American Journal of Neuroradiology,Journal of the Formosan Medical Association, Journal of Clinical & Experimental Neuropsychology, Child’s Nervous System, Applied Neuropsychology: Adult, Biomedical Journal, Journal of Neuropsychiatry and Clinical Neurosciences, The Clinical Neuropsychologist, Radiation Oncology, International Journal of Radiation Oncology, Biology, Physics. Neurosurgery,等国际期刊上.

讲座内容：

轻度头外伤(Mild traumatic brain injury, MTBI)后的脑震荡症候群（Post-concussion syndrome, PCS）为临床上相当常见的困扰虽然多数患者的症状可于受伤后三个月内有所改善，但少数却会受到PCS长期的负面影响。基于过去对于PCS的相关研究与临床经验，此次演讲将介绍MTBI以及PCS之可能成因，影响因素与处预方案。

讲座二

题    目：Individual differences in categorization strategy and working memory capacity

主讲人：杨立行副教授（台湾政治大学）

时    间：2017年6月26日（星期一）下午4:20-5:30

地    点：心理学院201会议室

主讲人简介：

台湾政治大学的副教授，主要研究领域：知识分区；分类学习和认知模型。其学术论文发表在Frontiers in Psychology: Quantitative psychology and measurement，Journal of Economic Interaction and Coordination，Emotion，Behavioral Research Methods，Behavioral Research Methods，Chinese Journal of Psychology，Memory& Cognition，Chinese Journal of Psychology,Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition，Chinese Journal of Applied Psychology等国际期刊上。

讲座内容：

Conaway and Kurtz (2016) showed clear individual differences on learning a partial XOR category structure. One group of participants learned to rely on the proximity to exemplars for categorization; whereas the other group generated a full XOR strategy for categorization. Whether working memory capacity (WMC) has something to do with their finding was the issue to pursue in this study. Two experiments replicated their findings in the supervised- and observational-learning paradigms. Also, WMC (measured in the MU, OS, SS, and SSTM tasks) was found to be negatively correlated with the tendency of using the XOR strategy for the XOR group but not for the Proximity group.The hierarchical Bayesian modeling results suggest that in addition to the Proximity strategy, the XOR group also generates the XOR strategy.It is implied that the high WMC ones can hold both strategies active in WM, hence having difficulty performing the typical XOR strategy.
